topic: Pets in your 72-hour plan: a simple checklist for the four-legged family members (food, water, carrier, ID, a calm routine)

content.hook: 3 days of food. For every pet.

slides.title: *3 days* of food. For every pet.
slides.body: A simple 72-hour checklist for your four-legged family.

slides.title: Food, water, *bowls*
slides.body: Three days of their usual food, water for them, a bowl, and any regular medication.

slides.title: Carrier, ID, *calm routine*
slides.body: Carrier, tagged collar, leash, recent photo. Keep feeding times steady. Routine calms pets.

content.caption:
Pet emergency kit: 3 days of food for every pet.

Your 72-hour plan should include the four-legged ones. Keep it simple:

• Food: three days of their usual food, plus a bowl
• Water: enough for them, not only for you
• Medication: whatever they take regularly
• Carrier, leash and a collar with a tag
• A recent photo and vet contact details, on paper
• A calm routine: same feeding times, a familiar blanket

Pack it once. Check it twice a year. Done.
